generic_domain.justification: The term 'diffusion models' is the most generic in this list as it serves as a broad category that encompasses more specific types like score-based diffusion models, generalized diffusion models, and even aspects of diffusion time estimation. These specific domains fall under the umbrella of the general understanding of diffusion models. Therefore, selecting 'diffusion models' provides the broadest coverage necessary to include all other listed domains without overlapping or being too specific.
